---
title: "Rate Data Visualization"
format: dashboard
editor: visual
server: shiny
---

```{r}
#| context: setup
#| echo: false
#| output: false

library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(DT)

# Load data
df <- read.csv("combinedratedata.csv", 
               check.names = FALSE, 
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

df$`Minimum Charge` <- as.numeric(gsub("[\\$,]", "", as.character(df$`Minimum Charge`)))
df$`Bill at 4,000 Gal (5.35 Ccf)` <- as.numeric(gsub("[\\$,]", "", as.character(df$`Bill at 4,000 Gal (5.35 Ccf)`)))
df$`Bill at 8,000 Gal (10.70 Ccf)` <- as.numeric(gsub("[\\$,]", "", as.character(df$`Bill at 8,000 Gal (10.70 Ccf)`)))

df <- df |> select(-any_of(c("Rates Effective Date", "Unit")))

# format dataset for box plots
df_long <- df |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Minimum Charge`, `Bill at 4,000 Gal (5.35 Ccf)`, `Bill at 8,000 Gal (10.70 Ccf)`),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(Value))
```

```{r}
fluidRow(
  column(
    width = 6,
    tags$label("Water Management District:"),          div(              style = "max-height: 200px; overflow-y: auto; border: 1px solid #ddd; padding: 8px; border-radius: 4px; background-color: #fff;",              checkboxGroupInput(                  inputId = "selected_wmd",                   label = NULL,                  choices = sort(unique(df$`Water Management District`)),
        selected = unique(df$`Water Management District`)
      )
    )
  )
)

selectInput(
  inputId = "selected_utility", 
  label = "Select Utility to Compare:",
  choices = sort(unique(df$`Utility Name`)),
  selected = "Toho Water Authority"
)
```

```{r}

plotOutput("comparison_plot")
```

```{r}
#| context: server

# 1. Render the comparison box plot
output$comparison_plot <- renderPlot({
  # Ensure inputs exist and are non-empty
  req(input$selected_utility, input$selected_wmd, 
      length(input$selected_wmd) > 0)
  
  target <- input$selected_utility
  
  # Filter the background distribution based on remaining filter selection
  filtered_df_long <- df_long |>
    filter(
      `Water Management District` %in% input$selected_wmd     )      
  # Validate that we have data to plot   
  validate(     need(nrow(filtered_df_long) > 0, "Please select at least one Water Management District.")   )      
  # Calculate number of unique organizations in the filtered peer group   
  n_orgs <- n_distinct(filtered_df_long$`Utility Name`)
  
  # Pull selected utility from the FULL dataset so the diamond stays visible 
  selected_df <- df_long |> 
    filter(`Utility Name` == target) |>
    rowwise() |>
    mutate(
      Percentile = round(mean(filtered_df_long$Value[filtered_df_long$Metric == Metric] <= Value, na.rm = TRUE) * 100)
    ) |>
    ungroup()
  
  # Generate horizontal box plots with metrics reordered by median value
  ggplot(filtered_df_long, aes(x = Value, y = fct_reorder(Metric, Value, .fun = median, .desc = TRUE))) +
    geom_boxplot(fill = "#e3eefd", alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA, height = 0.5) +
    geom_point(data = selected_df, aes(x = Value, y = fct_reorder(Metric, Value, .fun = median, .desc = TRUE)), 
               color = "#00AA65", size = 4, shape = 18) +
    geom_text(data = selected_df, 
              aes(x = Value, y = fct_reorder(Metric, Value, .fun = median, .desc = TRUE), 
                  label = paste0(target, ": $", sprintf("%.2f", Value), " (", Percentile, "%ile)")),
              hjust = -0.15, vjust = -0.5, color = "black", fontface = "bold", size = 6) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Rate Tier Comparison:", target, "vs. Industry Distribution"),
      subtitle = paste("Green diamonds indicate selected utility charges | Filtered peer group (n =", n_orgs, "utilities)"),
      x = "Amount ($)",
      y = ""
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(plot.title.position = "plot") +
    expand_limits(x = max(filtered_df_long$Value, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.35)
})

# 2. Render the interactive raw data table
output$raw_data_table <- DT::renderDT({
  req(input$selected_wmd, 
      length(input$selected_wmd) > 0)
  
  df |>
    filter(
      `Water Management District` %in% input$selected_wmd
    )
}, options = list(
  pageLength = 10,
  scrollX = TRUE,
  autoWidth = TRUE
))
```

#### Combined Rate Data Full Data

```{r}
DT::dataTableOutput("raw_data_table")
```
